primary_estimand: Declared-weight expected log-score gain per observed qualifying W/A/M endpoint from a frozen forecast in fixed held-out contexts.
secondary_estimand: Common biological supply-adjusted J only if the full count and bounded differential-recovery contract is admitted.
not_identified: Separate mutation, accessibility, establishment and recovery factors from winner counts alone
A novel causal force of natural dominance
Biological or all-category probabilities from J-only transfer bounds
Exact mutation or first-arrival times from endpoint outcomes
General power or a scientific discovery from synthetic verification

frozen_algorithm_candidate.model: pi proportional to qstar exp(theta 1_A + eta s)
frozen_algorithm_candidate.independent_feature: x = 0.5*log(F_W/F_M) from independent known-denominator establishment assays
frozen_algorithm_candidate.eta_prediction: training-only centered closed-form ridge regression with intercept and x
frozen_algorithm_candidate.missing_target_feature: blocked; no substitute from selected outcomes
comparator_predictions: Separate ridge regressions of training A:W and M:W log-odds offsets on intercept and x, with the same 0.01 slope penalty; normalize(qstar * [1, exp(g_A), exp(g_M)]).
frozen_algorithm_candidate.confidence_counts: raw admitted counts; do not substitute smoothed pseudo-counts
frozen_algorithm_candidate.uncertainty: One simultaneous outcome-probability region projected through all frozen score comparisons; does not identify latent parameters or causal effects.

transfer_rule: Unknown or unjustified biological control transfer is unbounded; do not estimate its bounds from held-out selected winners.

optional_exchangeable_context_envelope.finite_maximum_bound_requirement: m >= ceil(H/alpha_transfer - 1) for the allocated H-target union-bound construction; insufficient or unjustified exchangeability means no finite guarantee.

completion_boundary.next_action: Authenticate a common-background measurement partner or eligible source; resolve required registry fields, run blinded design/power work and independent review, then freeze/register before held-out endpoints.
